ASPD_BETA_GATE.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (1).

ASPD_BETA_NOISE.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.15).

ASPD_SCALE_NSD.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.0001).

ASPD_TAS_GATE.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (4).

BAT1_I_CHANNEL.note: Removed; the battery current ADC channel always comes from the board configuration and can no longer be overridden.

BAT2_I_CHANNEL.note: Removed; the battery current ADC channel always comes from the board configuration and can no longer be overridden.

BAT_ADC_CHANNEL.note: Was already unused (deprecated) in v1.17; removed.

COM_ARM_SDCARD.note: Removed; a missing SD card now always gives a warning (the old value 1). "Disabled" (0) and "Enforce SD card presence" (2) are no longer available.

COM_DISARM_MAN.note: Removed; disarming in flight with a stick, switch or button in manual thrust modes on multicopters is now always allowed (the old value 1).

COM_HLDL_REG_T.note: Removed; a regained high-latency link is used immediately (the old value 0).

COM_IMB_PROP_ACT.note: Removed; an imbalanced propeller now always gives a warning (the old value 0). To turn the check off (old -1), set FD_IMB_PROP_THR to 0. "Return" (1) and "Land" (2) are no longer available.

COM_KILL_DISARM.note: Removed; the vehicle disarms 5 s after the kill switch is engaged.

COM_LKDOWN_TKO.note: Removed; the time window for detecting a failure after takeoff is fixed at 3 s.

COM_MOT_TEST_EN.note: Removed; actuator testing can no longer be disabled.

COM_OBC_LOSS_T.note: Removed; onboard computer link loss is declared after 5 s.

COM_RC_ARM_HYST.note: Removed; arming and disarming with sticks or a button take 1 s (1000 ms).

COM_RC_OVERRIDE.note: Replaced by MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD: stick speed in 1/s, a negative value disables it. Only "disabled" (0) is converted, to MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD = -1. Otherwise override now works by stick speed and applies in both auto and offboard modes, on multicopters and VTOLs in multicopter mode.

COM_RC_STICK_OV.note: Replaced by MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD, which uses stick speed (1/s) instead of stick deflection (%). There is no conversion; check MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD (default 1.0).

COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.note: Removed; after takeoff the vehicle always switches to Hold (the old value 0). "Mission (if valid)" (1) is no longer available.

DSHOT_BIDIR_EN.note: Bidirectional DShot is now chosen per timer group in the output protocol parameters (PWM_MAIN_TIMn / PWM_AUX_TIMn, Actuators setup): BDShot150 (-8), BDShot300 (-7) or BDShot600 (-6). Not converted.

EKF2_AGP_CTRL.note: Replaced by the per-source EKF2_AGPn_CTRL. Not converted by v1.18.0-rc1. Put the value in EKF2_AGP0_CTRL; the source is only used once EKF2_AGP0_ID matches the id field of its AuxGlobalPosition messages (0 disables it), and a changed ID needs a reboot.

EKF2_AGP_DELAY.note: Replaced by the per-source EKF2_AGPn_DELAY. Not converted by v1.18.0-rc1. Put the value in EKF2_AGP0_DELAY; the source is only used once EKF2_AGP0_ID matches the id field of its AuxGlobalPosition messages (0 disables it), and a changed ID needs a reboot.

EKF2_AGP_GATE.note: Replaced by the per-source EKF2_AGPn_GATE. Not converted by v1.18.0-rc1. Put the value in EKF2_AGP0_GATE; the source is only used once EKF2_AGP0_ID matches the id field of its AuxGlobalPosition messages (0 disables it), and a changed ID needs a reboot.

EKF2_AGP_MODE.note: Replaced by the per-source EKF2_AGPn_MODE. Not converted by v1.18.0-rc1. Put the value in EKF2_AGP0_MODE; the source is only used once EKF2_AGP0_ID matches the id field of its AuxGlobalPosition messages (0 disables it), and a changed ID needs a reboot.

EKF2_AGP_NOISE.note: Replaced by the per-source EKF2_AGPn_NOISE. Not converted by v1.18.0-rc1. Put the value in EKF2_AGP0_NOISE; the source is only used once EKF2_AGP0_ID matches the id field of its AuxGlobalPosition messages (0 disables it), and a changed ID needs a reboot.

EKF2_GPS_DELAY.note: Replaced by the per-receiver SENS_GPS0_DELAY and SENS_GPS1_DELAY (integer ms).

FD_ACT_MOT_C2T.note: Motor failure detection was reworked. The closest new parameter, MOTFAIL_C2T, is a scale used with the offset MOTFAIL_OFF and has a different default (35 instead of 2.0); do not copy the value.

FD_ACT_MOT_THR.note: Removed with the motor failure detection rework; there is no replacement.

FD_ACT_MOT_TOUT.note: Replaced by MOTFAIL_TIME, in seconds instead of milliseconds, in the reworked motor failure detection (default 1 s instead of 100 ms). Not converted.

FD_ESCS_EN.note: The check of the ESCs' arming state now runs together with the motor failure check, both enabled by FD_ACT_EN, whose default changed from 1 to 0.

FW_AT_START.note: Was a trigger, not a setting. Autotune is now started with the autotune command from the ground station or with the AUX switch (FW_AT_MAN_AUX).

FW_T_SPD_DEV_STD.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.2).

FW_T_SPD_PRC_STD.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.2).

FW_T_SPD_STD.note: Removed; the value is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.07).

GF_PREDICT.note: The experimental pre-emptive geofence feature was removed.

INA226_CONFIG.note: Removed; the rewritten INA226 driver always uses its built-in configuration.

LNDMC_TRIG_TIME.note: Removed; the multicopter land detection time is fixed (1 s, the old default).

MC_AT_START.note: Was a trigger, not a setting. Autotune is now started with the autotune command from the ground station.

MNT_OFF_PITCH.note: Removed; set the gimbal output offset with the trim of that output in the Actuators setup instead.

MNT_OFF_ROLL.note: Removed; set the gimbal output offset with the trim of that output in the Actuators setup instead.

MNT_OFF_YAW.note: Removed; set the gimbal output offset with the trim of that output in the Actuators setup instead.

MNT_RANGE_PITCH.note: Replaced by MNT_MAX_PITCH and MNT_MIN_PITCH (half the range each way).

MOT_POLE_COUNT.note: Replaced by the per-motor DSHOT_MOT_POL1 to DSHOT_MOT_POL12.

MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.note: Replaced by bit 1 (landing nudging) of MPC_AUTO_NUDGING.

MPC_USE_HTE.note: Removed; the hover thrust estimate is always used for altitude control (the old value 1).
